courses.title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
courses.note: Elective for the Professional Computer Science concentration. The department scheduling pattern lists CSCI 4350 every Fall, including Fall 2025 evening offerings; courses absent from the pattern (including CSCI 3350) are on demand. Requirements checked against the 2026-27 academic map. Newest readable public syllabus located is in the September 2019 board packet, printed pages 155-157. Its December 13, 2018 final and September/October 2018 drop dates establish Fall 2018 despite a March 2019 last-modified stamp. The current course website returned only a page title through the required fetch tool, and the old course host failed DNS resolution; no newer syllabus could be read. Scheduling evidence: .cache/text/v2c-middle-tennessee-state-C5-1.txt.

courses.title: Introduction to Computer Systems
courses.note: Required upper-level computer systems course, different from C3, in the 2026-27 Professional Computer Science academic map (.cache/text/v2c-middle-tennessee-state-C6-2.txt). Catalog confirms machine-level code, memory management, networking and concurrency. Newest readable public syllabus located is explicitly Spring 2019 in the September 2019 board packet, printed pages 145-146. Searches for 2025 and 2026 offerings and departmental course pages did not locate a newer public syllabus.

notes: Frame taken from the 2026-27 Professional Computer Science academic map (core: CSCI 1170, 2170, 3080 Discrete Structures, 3110, 3130, 3240, 4700 and others) with titles from the MTSU banner catalog.
